title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Ice Prizm #242 Kevin Love Cleveland Cavaliers Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm sports trading card features Kevin Love from the Cleveland Cavaliers. The card is part of the Pink Ice Prizm parallel/variety set and is numbered 242 in the base set. It is a great addition to any collection for fans of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and basketball enthusiasts alike. 

The card is manufactured by Panini and is not autographed. It includes features such as the parallel/variety and base set and is from the 2020-21 season. This trading card is perfect for those looking to expand their sports trading card collection.
